action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check WorldTick constructor line numbers
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -n 'constructor.*ws' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts | head -3")
print("Constructor:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check lines around constructor
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -n '42,60p' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("\nLines 42-60:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
